about_page.title: About EVOLYX Digital
about_page.intro: EVOLYX Digital is the software development branch of the EVOLYX group. We design websites, apps and business software for Cameroonian companies, Francophone Africa, and international clients.
about_page.group_text: The EVOLYX group covers several activities. EVOLYX Shop is e-commerce. EVOLYX Digital builds the software: showcase sites, apps, back-offices, business tools. This site is not a store.
about_page.approach_title: We start from the problem, not a template
about_page.approach_text: Many agencies sell generic websites. We start from a concrete operation — inventory, records, checkout, messaging — and we ship the tool that runs it, including when the network is unstable.
about_page.value_1_text: The portfolio shows products in use, not mockups. If a project is still in progress, we say so.
about_page.value_2_title: One point of contact, end to end
about_page.value_2_text: Scoping, build, delivery, maintenance: you are not handed off from a salesperson to an anonymous freelancer.
about_page.value_3_text: French and English on the site, and in delivery, so we can work with local and international teams.
